text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah (Perancangan)
Wilayah Persekutuan (Kelas Kegunaan Tanah dan Bangunan)
(Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur) 2018.

 (2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 31 Oktober 2018.

Kelas kegunaan tanah dan bangunan

2. Bagi maksud memberikan kebenaran perancangan b erkenaan dengan suatu
pembangunan dalam Wilayah Persekut uan Kuala Lumpur di bawah seksyen 22 Akta,
kelas kegunaan tanah dan bangunan dalam zon kegunaan tanah hendaklah
sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Kepentingan awam

3. Dalam hal jika suatu permohonan bagi kebenaran perancangan berkenaan  dengan
suatu pembangunan adalah berhubung dengan kegunaan tanah dan bangunan yang
tidak dinyatakan dalam Jadual atau yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (4) Jadual,
Datuk Bandar boleh, dengan kelulusan Menteri, memberikan kebenaran perancangan
jika Dat uk Bandar berpandangan bahawa pembangunan itu mempunyai kepentingan
awam.

Pembatalan

4. Kaedah-Kaedah (Perancangan) (Kelas -Kelas Kegunaan) Bandaraya  Kuala Lumpur
1980 [P.U. (A) 78/1980] dibatalkan.

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (CLASSES OF USE OF LAND AND BUILDINGS)
(FEDERAL TERRITORY OF KUALA LUMPUR) RULES 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 64(2)(b) of the
Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [ Act 267 ], the Commissioner of the
City of Kuala Lumpur, with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning)
(Classes of Use of Land and Buildings)  (Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur)
Rules 2018.

 (2) These Rules come into operation on 31 October 2018.

Classes of use of land and buildings
2. For the purposes of granting planning permission in respect of a development in the
Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur under section 22 of the Act, the classes of use of land
and buildings in a land zone shall be as specified in the Schedule.

Public interest
3. In the case where an application for a planning permission in respect of a
development relates to a class of use of land and buildings which is not specified in the
Schedule or which is specified in column (4) of the Schedule, the  Commissioner may,
with the approval of the Minister, grant the planning permission if the Commissioner is
of the opinion that the development is of public interest.

Revocation
4. The City of Kuala Lumpur (Planning)  (Use Classes) Rules 1980 [ P.U. (A) 78/198 0]
are revoked.

DESCRIPTION OF CLASSES OF USE
Classes of Use

Description

Class A1 - Residential unit Any type of residential unit except serviced
apartment and Small Office Home Office (SOHO)

Class A2 - Quarters Any type of quarters for public servants or
employees of statutory bodies or other bodies

Class A3 - Hostel Any type of rented hostel

Class A4

- Care home Any type of residential unit used as a facility for
persons with disabilities, aged persons, children
or other groups of people requiring extra care,
attention or supervision which is not associated
to or part of any healthcare facility

Class A5 - Home-based business Any type of residential unit except serviced
apartment and SOHO which is also used for
carrying out a business with not more than two
employees

Class B1

- General retail Any commercial space used for general retails

Class B2

- Business Any commercial space used for a business

Class B3

- Office Any commercial space used for operating
an office

Class B4 - Financial institution Any commercial space used for f inancial o r
banking activities

Classes of Use

Description

Class B5 - Food and drink Any commercial space used for sale of food and
drink

Class B6 - Entertainment Any type of premises used for any form of
entertainment except theme park

Class B7 - Wellness Any commercial space used for wellness
activities

Class B8 - Gambling Any commercial space used for gambling
activities

Class B9

- Theme park Any type of indoor and outdoor theme parks

Class B10  - Tourist
accommodation

Any type of tourists accommodation

Class B11

- Serviced apartment Any type of serviced apartment

Class B12 - Small Office Home
Office (SOHO)
Any commercial space used for operating an
office and for residential purposes in one unit

Class B13 - Supermarket Any type of supermarket

Class B14 - Departmental store Any type of departmental store

Class B15

- Hypermarket Any type of hypermarket

Class B16 - Funeral services Any type of premises used for funeral services

Classes of Use

Description

Class C1 - Showroom Any type of showroom

Class C2 - Packaging, storage
and distribution
Any type of premises used for p ackaging,
storage and distribution of goods

Class C3 - Recycling Any type of premises used for recycling
of materials

Class C4 - Petrol station Any petrol station including its retail
establishments

Class C5 - Engineering work Any type of premises used for  engineering
works

Class C6 - Vehicles repair and
service
Any type of premises used for maintenance and
repair services of motor vehicles

Class C7 - Manufacturing and
processing
Any type of  premises used for  manufacturing,
processing and production of goods

Class C8 - Publishing and
printing
Any type of premises used for  publishing and
printing services

Class C9

- Technology, research
and development

Any type of premises used for  technology,
research and development activities

Class C10 - Batching plant Any site used for batching cement

Class D1 - Health facility Any type of premises used for provision of
healthcare services or health-related services

Classes of Use

Description

Class D2 - Religious facility Any religious facility

Class D3 - Education facility Any type of educational institution for any level
of education

Class D4 - Civic use Any type of premises used for public and culture
activities except community facility

Class D5 - Community facility Any type of premises used for specific
community activities

Class D6 - Sports and recreation
facility
Any type of premises used for sports and
recreational activities except golf facility

Class D7 - Golf facility Any area used as a golf facility

Class D8 - Institution and
organization
Any type of premises used for administration of
the Government or other organizations  except
for emergency and security purposes

Class D9 - Shelter home or
institution
Any type of premises used as a care and
rehabilitation facility provided by the
Government

Class D10 - Emergency and
security
Any type of premises used for operation of the
Government agencies dealing with emergency
and security matters

Classes of Use

Description

Class E1 - Transport facility Any type of premises used as a transportation
station or terminal including its retail
establishments

Class E2 - Park and ride Any type of premises used as a park and ride
facility

Class E3 - Parking Any type of premises used for parking of any
motor vehicles

Class E4 - Public utility Any type of premises used as a public utility
facility except solid waste facility

Class E5 - Solid waste facility Any type of premises used as a solid waste
management facility

Class E6 - Slaughtering centre Any type of premises used for slaugh tering
of birds
